fact: BCEAO Instruction No. 001-01-2024 of 23 January 2024, in force from signature, sets user protection rules for payment institutions (segregated funds, transparency) and requires a complaints scheme with a 7-working-day reply and recourse to the Commission Bancaire or the national financial services quality observatory (OQSF).
title: INSTRUCTION N°001-01-2024 RELATIVE AUX SERVICES DE PAIEMENT DANS L'UNION MONÉTAIRE OUEST AFRICAINE
